praise.name: YABO
praise.description: Ka fara sa'ar addu'arka ta wurin yabon Ubangiji. Ku yabe shi saboda abubuwan da ke zuciyar ku a yanzu. Ku yabe shi don wani abu na musamman da ya yi a rayuwar ku a cikin makon da ya gabata. Ku yabe shi saboda alherinsa ga iyalan ku.

wait.name: JIRA
wait.description: Ku ciyar da lokaci don jiran Ubangiji. Yi shiru kuma ku bar shi ya tattara muku tunani.

confess.name: YARDA
confess.description: Ka roki Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya nuna maka wani abu a rayuwarka wanda zai yi rashin jin daɗi a gare shi. Ka roƙe shi ya nuna halayen da ba daidai ba, da takamaiman ayyuka waɗanda har yanzu ba ka yi addu'ar ikirari da su ba. Yanzu ku shaida wa Ubangiji don a tsarkake ku.

read_the_word.name: KARANTA KALMAR
read_the_word.description: Ku ɓata lokaci don karanta Zabura, a cikin annabawa, ko kuma ayoyin addu'a da ke cikin Sabon Alkawari.

pray_the_word.name: ADDU'A MAGANAR
pray_the_word.description: Ka yi addu'a takamaiman wurare. Addu'o'in Nassi da kuma Zabura da yawa sun ba da kansu ga wannan dalilin.

thank.name: Na gode
thank.description: Ku gode wa Ubangiji saboda abubuwan da ke cikin rayuwar ku, a madadin dangin ku, da kuma madadin cocin ku.

sing.name: YIN KYAUTA
sing.description: ku raira waƙoƙin yabo ko sujada ko wata waƙa ko waƙa ta ruhaniya.

meditate.name: NAZARI
meditate.description: Ka tambayi Ubangiji ya yi magana da kai. Yi alkalami da takarda a shirye don yin rikodin abubuwan da Ya ba ku.

listen.name: KA SAURARA
listen.description: Ka ɓata lokaci ka haɗa abubuwan da ka karanta, abubuwan da ka yi addu'a da abubuwan da ka rera ka ga yadda Ubangiji ya tattara su duka su yi maka magana.

praise_end.name: YABO KA
praise_end.description: yabi Ubangiji saboda lokacin da ka yi tare da shi da kuma abubuwan da ya ba ka. Ku yabe shi saboda sifofinsa madaukaka.

aria.next_step: Tsallake zuwa matakin addu'a na gaba
aria.restart_cycle: Sake fara zagayowar addu'a daga farko

audio.title: Sauti
audio.description: Kunna sautunan laushi yayin canzawa tsakanin matakan addu'a

screen.title: Allo
screen.keep_awake: Kiyaye allo a farkare yayin addu'a
screen.description: Hana allo daga yin duhu ko kashe yayin lokutan addu'a
screen.not_supported: Kulle farkawa na allo ba a goyan baya a wannan mai bincike ba

theme.title: Jigo
theme.description: Zaɓi jigon launi da kuka fi so
